table.name: TLGNR_RETURN_QUANT_HANDLING_BS
table.description: Types/Status of returned quantity handling of an order item. Normally (if still possible by the workflow), the delivered quantity is adjusted, but if this had already been sent to SAP, a credit note might need to be created.

column.name: RETURN_QUANT_HANDLING_CD
column.description: PK. 0=no adjustment needed (or credit note refused), 1=delivered quantity adjustment needed, 2=delivered quantity adjusted, 3=credit note needed, 4=credit note created.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
